title: Adds enum values for disabled reasons
summary: Adds paused.inactivity and other as new disabled reasons in the Capabilities API. To learn more, see Capability disabled reasons.
migrationNotes: You now encounter these additional reasons when a capability is disabled, providing more specific information about the cause of the disability.

Adds `paused.inactivity` and `other` as new disabled reasons in the Capabilities API. To learn more, see [Capability disabled reasons](https://docs.stripe.com/api/accounts/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20#capability_object-requirements-disabled_reason).
